body_markdown:
[Brooklyn](https://www.renthop.com/nyc/brooklyn-apartments) is a popular borough for renters who seek large units, amenities, and proximity to hot spots across the city. Renters can consider Brooklyn listings in September of 2026 under $4,500 and find neighborhoods with unique communities with units below[Manhattan’s](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/manhattan-new-york-ny) pricing.


The average rent for a[New York City apartment](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/new-york-ny) this month has dropped again to[$4,875](https://www.renthop.com/average-rent-in/new-york-ny) . Now that we are leaving the peak summer rental season, renters must still stay extra vigilant if they want to find a cost-effective apartment. Due to the declining number of options this time of year. The following Brooklyn listings in September of 2026 under $4,500 offer private balconies, in-unit washer and dryer, fitness centers, and more.


## Best Brooklyn Listings in September of 2026 under $4,500


### [1. 248 McKibbin Street #4U](https://www.renthop.com/listings/248-mckibbin-street/4u/76694126/show)

Price: $3,950


Size: Studio/ Flex 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 3.40%


First up this month, we’re covering a bright and sunny Williamsburg loft. The unit comes with wall-to-wall double-paned factory windows, tin ceilings, hardwood planks, overhead storage, kitchen appliances, and gas heater. Additionally, future renters will be able to enjoy a massive rooftop with Manhattan skyline views and multiple laundry rooms.

## Methodology


Released on a monthly basis, the RentHop Best Deal series aims to provide renters with useful market insights and a chance to identify rental gems currently available on the market. These listings are hand-selected by the team at[RentHop](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/new-york-ny) based on a few factors, including layout, apartment size, features, and, more importantly, price.


Note that, given the fast-paced nature of the rental market in New York, certain Brooklyn listings may receive applications and be taken off the market within days. If you are interested in scheduling a showing or have further questions, please make sure to submit an inquiry via the inquiry submission form located on the listing page.
